snippet.title: Game Boy Color - Pop n Pop © 2000 Taito - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Help Yogi Bear, Boo Boo and Cindy Bear as they turn the Jellystone Park - "Balloon Fest" upside down. Using balloons to avoid Ranger Smith and float awa with a few picnic baskets. Yogi and friends plan to stock with some extra goodies and have a little party of their own.

- Choose from Yogi Bear, Boo Boo or Cindy Bear as you race to connect three or more of the same-colored balloons to cause a balloon-popping chain reaction.
- Pop all the balloons before they hit the ground to get one step closer to those delicious pic-a-nic baskets.
- Fully compatible with the Game Link cable for fun two-player action.
